newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: City of Buenos Aires to launch bonds. [CORRECTED 03:20 GMT]
newsitem.headline: City of Buenos Aires to launch bonds. [CORRECTED 03:20 GMT]

text.p: Argentina's city of Buenos Aires will launch up to $500 million worth of bonds in domestic and international markets on Monday, state-run agency Telam said Sunday. (Corrects to show that the city, not province, is issuing bonds and that the amount is up to, not exactly, $500 million.)
The bonds will be launched in the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange and $100 million will be channeled to capitalise the state-run Banco de la Ciudad de Buenos Aires.
Chase Manhattan Bank will be the lead manager in international markets, Telam said without elaborating.
